title: PDNO Control Benchmark: Revision Experiments, Model Checkpoints, and Raw Evidence
description: Code, selected model checkpoints, synthetic data, raw outcomes and request timings accompanying the submission draft When Candidate-Based Neural-Operator Control Loses to Modal Feedback: Separating Predictor Error, Controller Design, and Execution-Regime-Dependent Tail Latency in a PDE Benchmark, by Hyojin Park and Jinhong Yang. Version 1.1.0 preserves the original campaign and adds reference-solver candidate comparisons, enlarged Burgers training, a single-seed loss-weight sweep, a new nonnegative-initial-field heat evaluation, and candidate-count/cache timing probes. Includes 50 selected revision checkpoints and original protected checkpoints; binary evidence is supplied as 11 independent ZIP archives with a SHA-256 manifest. Provides figure/table regeneration, CPU implementation and checkpoint checks, and saved-array arithmetic audits. Historical runners are not a one-command fresh GPU replication interface. The findings are conditional on the executed controller designs and timing setup and do not establish deployment safety or isolated causality. IEEE manuscript templates and author portraits are excluded from the software archive. The paper is not an accepted publication.
